lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to cleanse the Levites with purification water and have them take a young bull.
The LORD tells Moses to bring the Levites to the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron to present them.
The LORD took the Levites in place of Israel's firstborn, whom He set apart when He struck down Moab's firstborn.
Levite men thirty years or older enter the work at the Tent of Meeting, and at fifty they retire.
